items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: playing “Love for Sale” by Buddy Rich

ctx.x: Yeah that’s a really interesting phenomenon, the jazz parties. I wonder if you see, are the audiences maintaining themselves?

Pretty good. Pretty good. It’s the aging audience is a problem that I don’t think any of us know quite how to deal with it. I mean we all would love to get all the kids involved but we know it’s probably not going to happen maybe in our lifetime. And you go places and here’s an example. I think we played down in Vero Beach with my 8-piece group you know. My 8-piece band, we’ll start from playing “The Chant” and go all the way up to playing “Love for Sale” by Buddy Rich. Stuff like that. Try to expand their…
I know. “Wait, there’s something for you here to listen to.”
